```plato

    // The binomial coefficient C(n, k), "n choose k", by the multiplicative
    // recurrence C(n, k) = C(n - 1, k - 1) * n / k, which avoids forming the
    // factorials. Precondition: 0 <= k <= n (outside that range the result is
    // meaningless; callers guard the support first).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binomial_coefficient
    BinomialCoefficient(n: Integer, k: Integer): Number
        => k <= 0 || k >= n
            ? 1.0
            : BinomialCoefficient(n - 1, k - 1) * n.ToNumber / k.ToNumber;
```
